gap.$description: Space between the label and the bar.

font-family.$description: Font family of the label and the value.

value-font-size.$description: Font size of the value, after the label.

text-color.$description: Text color of the label and the value.

border-radius.$description: Corner radius of the bar and of its indicator.

track-color.$description: Color of the bar, behind its indicator.

track-border-color.$description: Color of the border of the bar: where it ends (WCAG 1.4.11).

track-border-width.$description: Width of the border of the bar.

duration.$description: Duration of one pass of an indeterminate bar: slower with reduced motion.
